title: Zhentarim Key
summary: Three same-name keys open two different Zhentarim Basement gates.

fields.Zarys and Vol: Their keys open the western storage gate, left of the button, at (282, −174). The room contains two trapped wooden chests.
fields.Jarg: His key opens the eastern office gate, right of the button, at (304, −177). The office chest contains Abyss Beckoners.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Zarys, Vol and Jarg in the Zhentarim Basement.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
